lesson_intro.heading: Cloud Engineer · PM-3.2
lesson_intro.board_text:
Auto Scaling Groups
Finova · finova-dev · ap-south-1

Why before how:
Festival traffic must add and remove capacity without human heroics.

Mental model:
ASG = desired/min/max + health replace. Policy decides when.

You will: watch → learn → practice one navigation.

whiteboard_intro.board_text:
Auto Scaling Groups
• ASG = desired/min/max + health replace. Policy decides when.
• Mistake: Fixed fleet sized for peak 24/7 — burning ₹.
• Habit: Scale on a metric that matches user pain — not vanity CPU only.
